claims.assertion: Mari Swa describes Second Contact as a Taygetan-only project to seed social media with values and concepts from interstellar societies.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says the operation was planned for later that year.

claims.assertion: Mari says Federation authorization required Earth-made digital communications and that Taygetan participants would conceal their extraterrestrial identities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says private one-to-one contact was discouraged.

review_flags: The source describes an unverified alleged extraterrestrial social media operation.
coverage_gaps: It also outlines the failed prior project and proposed staffing, platforms, and ships.
